card.sourceRow: Signing/licence inventory: OS/hardware, existing Apple membership, exact app/extension entitlements, Cold Turkey Pro, Porcupine licence/model. Record available/deferred branch without buying.
card.scopeRule: No decision is needed for the zero-spend default. Any later membership or licence purchase requires its own scoped decision; absent approval stays deferred.

assignedAssertions.assertion: Absent Apple Developer membership or Cold Turkey Pro selects web/PWA plus Discord, defers native-only features and gates R4 app blocking, without paid purchase or dependable weekly free re-signing.

Unknown Apple membership/licence/entitlements require written feasibility before native implementation or activation; absent membership defers native app/push/share/alarm; web PWA plus Discord remains zero-spend with no weekly provisioning or assumed purchase.

Unknown OS/hardware, Apple membership, signing, Family Controls permission, Cold Turkey Pro and Porcupine eligibility are inventoried without purchase or change; dependent capabilities stay deferred unless separately supported by evidence; trials and weekly re-signing are not dependable production coverage.

currentOwnerBehavior.publicOwner: NativeReleaseEligibilityPolicy.evaluate is exported by packages/ops/src/public.ts and reached by the registered native-release-eligibility probe through the existing toy probe.run/show commands.
currentOwnerBehavior.policy: The policy parses the generated V1 input, accepts a prerequisite only when its state is verified, at least one evidence link is present and checkedAt is not later than observedAt, and independently computes each capability's missing prerequisites. Native app/share/push/alarm/Family Controls require OS/hardware, Apple membership, signing, their entitlements and Cold Turkey Pro; Family Controls also requires its permission. App blocking requires OS/hardware and Cold Turkey Pro. Wake word requires OS/hardware and Porcupine licence/model. The default output is web-pwa-plus-discord; purchaseAssumed, weeklyFreeProvisioningCounted and liveActivationAdmitted are always false.
currentOwnerBehavior.evidenceBoundary: The policy consumes evidence links; it does not authenticate those links or query accounts. The CLI probe labels every input as a fixed external prerequisite fixture. Its synthetic verified fixture is not live eligibility evidence, membership/licence proof or activation authority. A future evidence-owning source must validate provenance before supplying real inventory; no such provider is present in this assigned code path.
currentOwnerBehavior.versionedInterface: NativeReleaseEligibilityInputV1 and NativeReleaseEligibilityDecisionV1 already exist in generated contracts, with the written boundary in docs/adr/0028-native-release-eligibility.md. No interface amendment is needed for the no-spend policy subset.
